# The two flat roofs (top at glTF y 0) either side of a 1 m alley, their front facades with windows
# down to y -3.2, a parapet along the front edge and one at each outer end. Textured tops:
# textures/roof_tar.png (left), roof_tile.png (right), projected from the top. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Tar --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Tar base-color textures/roof_tar.png
material new Tile --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Tile base-color textures/roof_tile.png
material new Brick --base-color 0.388 0.106 0.204 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.043 0.541 0.561 --no-slot
material new Lit --base-color 0.055 0.686 0.608 --no-slot --emission 0.055 0.686 0.608
material new Dark --base-color 0.196 0.325 0.373 --no-slot
material new Floor --base-color 0.255 0.114 0.192 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name BlockL --size 1 --location -3.700 -0.500 -1.600
scale 6.400 5.400 3.200
apply --scale
material assign Brick
select BlockL
active BlockL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9 || normal.x < -0.9 || normal.x > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select BlockL
active BlockL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Tar
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name ParapetL --size 1 --location -3.700 -3.075 0.130
scale 6.400 0.250 0.260
apply --scale
material assign Brick
select ParapetL
active ParapetL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name PCapL --size 1 --location -3.700 -3.075 0.300
scale 6.480 0.330 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Cap
select PCapL
active PCapL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

active EndL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
